priorityList: Pre-combat: Summon your primary pet and use Power Siphon to generate Demonic Core stacks.
Sync Potions, Power Infusion, and offensive Racials with the Summon Demonic Tyrant window.
Use offensive trinkets during Summon Demonic Tyrant or if the Tyrant cooldown is longer than 20 seconds.
Cast Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks remaining.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan immediately if the Dominion of Argus hero talent buff is active.
Cast Grimoire: Fel Guard (or Grimoire: Fel Ravager) on cooldown.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant on cooldown.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan whenever you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Use Infernal Bolt if available and you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
If talented into Doom, use Demonbolt with a Demonic Core stack to apply the Doom debuff to targets missing it.
Cast Demonbolt with Demonic Core procs if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
Use Shadow Bolt as your filler to generate Soul Shards.
